items.mechanism: CLAIM:network.https@Page:Query two Overpass HTTPS endpoints using the injected wx request adapter, with bounded attempts, timeout, cancellation, cached fallback and explicit recovery.
CLAIM:device.geolocation@Page:Read companion-host GPS coordinates and moving course through an injected watchPosition adapter; clear watches and ignore stale or revoked delivery.
CLAIM:device.compass@Page:Use optional host Accelerometer and Magnetometer factories for approximate compass heading; expire readings and fall back to GPS or manual direction.
CLAIM:storage.local-cache@Page:Persist selected language, settings and up to three downloaded mountain areas through injected wx local-storage methods; surface denied storage and corrupt cache.
